compounding.definitionKo: 두 가지 이상이 하나로 합침. 또는 두 가지 이상을 하나로 합침.
compounding.englishDescription: More than two things being united; the act of uniting more than two things.

compounding.definitionKo: 언어에서, 둘 이상의 실질 형태소가 붙어서 하나의 단어를 만듦. 또는 그런 일.
compounding.englishDescription: In a language, an act of producing a word by combining two or more full morphemes together, or such a process.

hemoglobin.definitionKo: 적혈구 속에 있으며 산소를 운반하며 피의 붉은 빛깔을 내는 물질.
hemoglobin.englishDescription: A red-colored substance in red blood cells, which carries oxygen

kind.englishDescription: A facial expression or state of mind being tender.

kind.definitionKo: 무엇의 한 종류. 또는 한 가지.
kind.englishDescription: A kind of something; one thing.

kind.definitionKo: 마음씨나 하는 행동, 말투가 부드럽고 상냥하며 친절하다.
kind.englishDescription: One's attitude, behavior, or speech being nice, soft, and kind.

kind.definitionKo: 어떤 기준에 따라 여러 가지로 나눈 갈래.
kind.englishDescription: One of many classes into which something is divided according to certain criteria.

kind.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 공통적인 성격에 따라 나눈 갈래.
kind.englishDescription: One of the groups into which subjects are divided by common characteristics.
A bound noun used to indicate the type of a thing.
One's mind or behavior being sincere, kind and affectionate.
One's personality or attitude being bright, sweet, and kind.

kind.definitionKo: 마음씨나 행동 등이 곱고 바르며 상냥하다.
kind.englishDescription: One's heart, behavior, etc., being honest, nice, and friendly.

kind.definitionKo: 성격이 매우 얌전하고 착하다. 또는 매우 공손하고 부드럽다.
kind.englishDescription: One's personality being quiet and docile; very courteous and gentle.
Kind and gentle in the way one speaks and acts.

kind.definitionKo: 성질이나 태도가 밝고 부드러우며 친절한 듯하다.
kind.englishDescription: One's personality or attitude seeming to be bright, sweet, and kind.

kind.definitionKo: 다른 것들과 차이가 나는 특징을 가지는 형태나 유형.
kind.englishDescription: A type or form that has a feature different from that of another.

kind.definitionKo: 어떠한 구조나 전체를 이루고 있는 사물이 일정하게 갖추고 있는 모양.
kind.englishDescription: A certain form taken by an object that comprises a structure or whole.

kind.definitionKo: 어떤 기준에 따라 여러 가지로 나눈 갈래.
kind.englishDescription: Any of the categories into which something is divided.

make-up.definitionKo: 화장품을 바르거나 문질러 얼굴을 예쁘게 꾸밈.
make-up.englishDescription: The act of making oneself look more beautiful by applying cosmetics over the face.

object.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 대상이 되는 도구, 사물, 사람, 재료를 나타내는 말.
object.englishDescription: A word that is usually used with another noun to mean that a tool, thing, person, or material becomes the object of ridicule,  material for making fire, etc.
Something that exists in a concrete form.

object.definitionKo: 사람이 감각하거나 인식하거나 행동하는 것의 대상이 되는 사물.
object.englishDescription: An object which is sensed, recognized, or has something done to it.

object.definitionKo: 문장 안에서 서술어의 동작이 미치는 대상.
object.englishDescription: The object of the verb in a sentence.

object.definitionKo: 그릇이나 가구 등과 같이 일상생활에 쓰는 여러 가지 물건.
object.englishDescription: Various things used in everyday life such as dishes, furniture, etc.

object.definitionKo: 타동사가 쓰인 문장에서 동작의 대상이 되는 말.
object.englishDescription: A word that is the target of an action in a sentence with a transitive verb.

object.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 주장이나 의견에 반대하여 말하다.
object.englishDescription: To say something against someone's argument or opinion.

object.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 의견 등에 따르지 않고 거스르다.
object.englishDescription: To be against a certain behavior, opinion, etc., without following it.

object.definitionKo: 직접 보거나 만질 수 있게 일정한 모양과 성질을 갖추고 있는, 세상의 온갖 물건.
object.englishDescription: All kinds of things with a certain shape and property so as to allow one to see or touch.

object.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 의견 등을 따르지 않고 거스르게 되다.
object.englishDescription: To be against a certain behavior, opinion, etc., without following it.

ppun.definitionKo: 다만 그것만이고 그 이상은 아님을 나타내는 말.
ppun.englishDescription: A bound noun indicating that there is nothing more than that.

ppun.definitionKo: 오직 그렇게 하거나 그러하다는 것만 한정함을 나타내는 말.
ppun.englishDescription: A bound noun indicating that a person only acts a certain way or that he/she is confined to doing just as he/she does.

ppun.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용 이외에 더는 없거나 오직 그러함을 나타내는 조사.
ppun.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used when there is nothing more than the content of the preceding statement or when it is only so.

reapply.englishDescription: To reapply on something that was already applied.
To reapply on something that was already applied.

recklessly.englishDescription: In a careless and reckless manner.
In a thoughtless and careless manner.

recklessly.definitionKo: 갑자기 나서서 생각 없이 자꾸 말을 함부로 하는 모양.
recklessly.englishDescription: A word describing one suddenly saying something randomly and repeatedly without thinking.

recklessly.definitionKo: 갑자기 나서서 생각 없이 말을 함부로 하는 모양.
recklessly.englishDescription: A word describing one suddenly saying something randomly without thinking.

recklessly.definitionKo: 아무렇게나 마구. 또는 자기가 하고 싶은 대로.
recklessly.englishDescription: In a reckless and disorderly manner, or as one pleases.
Without the carefulness with which one can think about the cause or effect of an incident.

reign.definitionKo: 절대적인 힘이나 능력으로 남을 누르고 지배적인 세력을 가지다.
reign.englishDescription: To control others with absolute power or ability from a dominant position.
An act of taking on and ruling a country or region.
To take on and rule a country or region.

retire.englishDescription: To give up what one is doing or position one is holding, and leave.
To quit social life and stay indoors.

retire.definitionKo: 하고 있던 일, 차지하고 있던 자리나 지위 등을 내놓고 떠나다.
retire.englishDescription: To give up what one is doing,  or a place or position one is holding, and leave.

retire.definitionKo: 하고 있던 일, 차지하고 있던 자리나 지위 등을 내놓다.
retire.englishDescription: To give up what one is doing,  or a place or position one is holding.

retire.definitionKo: 하고 있던 일, 차지하고 있던 자리나 지위 등을 내놓다.
retire.englishDescription: To give up what one is doing,  or a place or position one is holding.
To give up one's position, interest, etc.

retire.definitionKo: 하던 일에서 물러나거나 사회 활동을 그만두어 한가히 지내다.
retire.englishDescription: To lead a leisurely life after resigning from one's job or stopping one's social activities.
To resign from one's job, at one's retirement age.
To resign from a job one has had.
To resign from a job or duty.
To resign voluntarily from one's present job or duty.

retire.definitionKo: 어떤 조직의 구성원 전체나 그 책임자가 물러나다.
retire.englishDescription: For all the members or the head of a certain organization to retire.
To lead a leisurely life after resigning from one's public position.

ssireum.definitionKo: 두 사람이 서로 상대의 샅바를 잡고 기술이나 힘을 겨루어 먼저 넘어뜨리는 쪽이 이기는 한국의 민속 운동 경기.
ssireum.englishDescription: Traditional Korean sport game, in which two contestants hold the thigh band of each other and compete in physical strength or techniques, and one wins by toppling the opponent first.
